gloss: jack of all trades, master of none

definitions.gloss: jack of all trades, master of none
definitions.explanation: Being good at many things and so never excelling at, or profiting from, any one of them; also a person like that.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{器用貧乏|きようびんぼう}だ。
examples.english: He's a jack of all trades and master of none.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{器用貧乏|きようびんぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{終|お}わりたく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I can do anything, but I don't want to end up a jack of all trades.

examples.japanese: {器用貧乏|きようびんぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: So as not to end up a jack of all trades, I decided to study one field in depth.

notes:
⟦{器用|きよう}→器用：02655_kiyou⟧ (skillful) + ⟦{貧乏|びんぼう}→貧乏：19466_binbou⟧ (poor): so handy at everything that you end up with nothing to show for it. Usually self-deprecating or mildly critical.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {器用貧乏|きようびんぼう}だ / {器用貧乏|きようびんぼう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧
- {器用貧乏|きようびんぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ / {器用貧乏|きようびんぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{終|お}わる
